pcs.pc_description: clean and maintain the work area as per organizational procedures
clean and maintain the machines and tools and sanitize them as per the organization's specifications and standards
• dispose of the waste material at designated place safely • Waste material: hazardous waste, food waste, packaging waste, etc.
inspect the tools, equipment, and machinery to ascertain suitability for use
check cleaning and effectiveness of magnets of measuring scales and see they are appropriately installed and also do calibration of metal detector by dash
report information such as faulty tools and equipment to the concerned authority
• procure food grade vitamin and mineral premix • premix: Iron, folic acid, Vitamin B12 etc.
procure wheat to prepare for fortification process by checking the specification limit
• ensure the obtained wheat meets the specified parameters and standards • Parameters: shelf life, cooking quality, etc.
discard the raw material which does not meet the standards
ensure the obtained premix meets the standards set by FSSAI
• arrange and store the ingredients properly in a designated area • Ingredients: wheat grain, food grade vitamin and mineral premix
• set controls for automatic measuring scales in continuous process to transfer measured quantity of wheat for milling • Controls: weight, screens, sizes, sieves, rpm, time, etc.
check condition of bucket elevator, chain conveyor, screw conveyor for any damage
ensure proper lubrication of machine parts done with food grade lubricants

adjust and control speed of screw, chain conveyor by gear of rpm motor attached with it to maintain flow rate of material to and from each processing machines to maintain production requirements and achieving continuous processing
check all sensors attached are in working condition to maintain the flow rate
set controls of blowers or suction fan to remove light impurities and dust particles from screens and sieves
• adjust the speed of the separator, aspirator, etc. to remove light weight impurities from grains • Impurities: dust, soil, chaff, twigs, broken grain, insects, etc.
transfer the grains to the de-stoner machine to remove stones and prepare the grains for washing

• set the controls for water bath and set the time of the conditioner for soaking, conditioning and tempering of grains for further processing • Controls: water level, temp, inflow and outflow rate etc.
adjust temperature, pressure and speed of dryer to maintain required moisture in grains
adjust valves to control the speed of the dryer to regulate amount of grain (par boiled grain) conveyed into dryer

• set parameters of husker to remove husk from the grain by adjusting the rollers (of rubber roll huskers) and setting the clearance between the rollers • Parameters: roller speed, clearance, emery size, etc.
adjust speed of the aspirator fan to separate de-husked grains
control the stream of air passing through cylinder to cool the grain and to blow off the bran
grade the processed grain based on length by controlling the rotation of the cylinders
adjust the speed of the sifter and use proper sieve size to remove the broken grains and transfer them to the grinder for milling
grade the desired grains into wheat flour as per the desired size
collect sample of the processed wheat flour and transfer to quality lab for analysis
store the wheat flour for further processing

modules.module_title: Perform production of wheat flour preblend

pcs.pc_description: transfer some milled wheat flour into a mixer/blender by using conveyors or organisational specified procedure for the mixing process
feed the premix into hopper and start the rotating screw type volumetric feeder for transferring the required quantity for premix into mixer/blender for mixing with wheat flour
• set the parameters of volumetric feeder for mixing process • parameters: motor speed, feed screw speed etc.
monitor mixing process to achieve required result throughout the process
pack the wheat flour preblend and store it by following organisational procedures
• send the sample to quality lab for analysis • analysis: nutritional content, colour, impurities etc.

modules.module_title: Perform production of fortified wheat flour

pcs.pc_description: transfer the milled wheat flour and preblend into big mixer/blender by using conveyors or organisational specified procedure for the mixing process
start the mixer/blender and allow the milled wheat flour and preblend to mix properly
collect the samples of fortified wheat flour after mixing process
• send the sample to quality lab for analysis • analysis: moisture, nutritional content, (vitamin and mineral in premix) kernel size, colour etc.
monitor the process loss by controlling the factors affecting stability during the fortification process
ensure the mixture is properly blended during mixing to avoid any loss

modules.module_title: Ensure proper storage and packaging of fortified flour

pcs.pc_description: start conveyors and elevators to transfer finished products to packing machine
• fill the packaging material with the feed as per the standard operating practices • Packaging material: HDPE, LDPE, cartons, etc.
operate packaging/bagging machinery by setting controls like batch code, date coding and filling quantity, printing mark, sealer temp and pressure etc
perform shelf-life study of fortified wheat flour to maintain its shelf stability
report any non-conformity in the process to the higher authority

• ensure the mandatory information are printed on the label of the bag • Information: Name, Net weight, name of supplier, production date, list of ingredients in descending order, country of origin, lot identification, storage instructions, ‘+F’ logo, etc.
store the fortified wheat flour under ventilated and hygienic conditions for further transportation
store the tools and materials used for production safely in designated places

pcs.pc_description: clean and maintain the work area as per organizational procedures
clean and maintain the machines and tools and sanitize them as per the organization's specifications and standards
• dispose of the waste material at designated place safely • Waste material: hazardous waste, food waste, packaging waste, etc.
inspect the tools, equipment, and machinery to ascertain suitability for use
report information such as faulty tools and equipment to the concerned authority
• identify food grade vitamin and mineral premix • premix: Vitamin B12, Iron, folic acid
procure broken rice after rice milling to prepare for fortification process by checking the specification limit
• ensure the obtained rice meets the parameters as per standards of normal rice • Parameters: strong to sustain shelf life, cooking quality, etc.
pass the broken rice through a vibro separator to check the presence of foreign material as well as through magnets to assure absence of any magnetic particles
discard the raw material which does not meet the standards
ensure the obtained premix meets the standards set by FSSAI
• arrange and store the ingredients properly in a designated area • Ingredients: Rice, food grade vitamin and mineral premix, FSSAI approved acid regulators and emulsifiers, potable water

modules.module_title: Perform production of fortified rice kernels

pcs.pc_description: transfer the approved broken rice into a pulverizer to grind it further to a desired size
• sieve the broken rice to check the standard particle size and removal of foreign particles • standard particle size: 150 μm
ensure the moisture content of broken rice before the mixing process should be in a range 11-12%
mix the vitamin and mineral premix with the broken rice in a flour mixer layer by layer
transfer the mixture into a preconditioner to add steam into the mixture for partial gelatinization of starch
transfer the mixture into a feeding hopper with a screw conveyor or manually to incorporate water in it
monitor the temperature and moisture content of the mixture in the hopper with a temperature moisture detector gun
transfer the moist fortified flour into a twin- screw extruder for partial cooking and extruding rice shaped kernels
ensure the main, feeding and cutting motor works properly in maintaining the shape and size of the kernels
• monitor the extrusion parameters to achieve consistency throughout the process • parameters: Feed rate, temperature and rotation speed of motor
measure the length, thickness and width of the extruded kernel to match the specification
cool the extruded kernels to remove moisture and temperature in a vibratory pan conveyor
transfer the extruded fortified kernels into five layered dryer through a pneumatic line or manually to reduce the moisture content of fortified rice kernels to 11-12%
maintain the temperature parameter of the vibratory dryer
transfer the fortified rice kernels from the dryer into a vibro separator to check and remove any clumps and extraneous matter
pass the kernels through a permanent bar magnet to check the presence of metal in fortified rice kernels
• send the sample to quality lab for analysis • analysis: moisture, nutritional content, (vitamin and mineral in premix) kernel size, colour etc.

modules.module_title: Perform production of blended fortified rice

pcs.pc_description: fill one hopper with fortified rice kernel and other with normal rice for batch blending
ensure the dosing system feeds the fortified rice kernel to normal rice in a designated ratio or as required to meet the fortified rice specification
set the combination of dosing parameters of a vibratory feeder in a continuous blending process
ensure the helical ribbon blender blends the mixture to produce homogenous fortified rice
ensure the steps of blending are performe just prior to packaging the fortified rice
• send the sample of finished product to quality lab to check quality parameters • parameters: moisture content, texture, broken kernels, organoleptic quality, pesticide residue, etc.

• monitor the process loss by controlling the factors affecting stability during the fortification process • process loss: applied heat, humidity during heating, drying steps, presence, or absence of air
monitor the stability of fortified rice during storage by using antioxidant for stabilization of vitamin A
ensure the mixture is properly blended during mixing to avoid washing loss
monitor the loss of water-soluble vitamins during cooking process by using FSSAI approved Emulsifiers

modules.module_title: Ensure proper storage and packaging of fortified rice

pcs.pc_description: dispose the rejected batch safely following the standard practice of the organization
pack the fortified rice in two-layer bag with inner layer of poly lining or equivalent packaging material
ensure the packed bag passes the butt drop and flat drop test
perform shelf-life study of fortified rice to maintain its shelf stability
report any non-conformity in the process to the higher authority

• ensure the mandatory information are printed on the label of the bag • Information: Name, Net weight, name of supplier, production date, list of ingredients in descending order, country of origin, lot identification, storage instructions, ‘+F’ logo, etc.
store the fortified rice under dry, ventilated, and hygienic conditions for further transportation
store the tools and materials used for production safely in designated places
maintain the tools, equipment and materials used for production as per standard practices
